name: Campingbuffet Hiasenhof
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Campingbuffet Hiasenhof in Tirol!**

Discover the perfect blend of nature and comfort in the heart of the **Alps**. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, our family-run campsite offers a cozy retreat with stunning mountain views.

**Enjoy our famous breakfast buffet**—start your day with fresh bread, homemade jams, crispy bacon, fluffy scrambled eggs, and our signature **Kaiserschmarrn**, served with powdered sugar and fresh fruit. For coffee lovers, we have a selection of fine **Kaffee** and **Espresso** to kickstart your adventure.

After breakfast, explore the surrounding trails or relax by our campfire area. In the evening, savor traditional **Tiroler** dishes like **Käsespätzle** or a hearty **Schweinsbraten** with dumplings and fresh garden salads.

**Campingbuffet Hiasenhof**—where every meal is a taste of **Tirol**’s hospitality!
